facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/rumble:.bss
facts.value: HSD_PadRumbleInit resets all four records from the unit's zero-valued template. Direct-control routines write `direct_status`; add, free, remove, and pause operations mutate the per-record list head, list count, or linked requests. HSD_PadRumbleInterpret reads every record during controller servicing, writes its current `status`, reclaims completed requests, compares the result with `last_status`, sends changed states to PADControlMotor, and caches the emitted state.

facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/rumble:.bss
facts.value: Each array element independently tracks one controller channel. Its direct state remains latched until explicitly changed, while its list head and count describe queued timed effects. During each interpretation pass, `status` is reset, optionally seeded from `direct_status`, and then overwritten by active unpaused effects in list order. A motor command is emitted only when the final state differs from `last_status`, after which `last_status` is updated; initialization clears all fields in all four records.

facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/rumble:HSD_PadRumbleInit
facts.value: A twelve-node backing array and its count originate at game controller startup, pass through HSD_PadInit, and are stored in HSD_PadLibData.rumble_info as the pool capacity and free-list head. Initialization links each supplied node to its successor and terminates the chain with null. HSD_PadRumbleAdd later consumes nodes from this head, while HSD_PadRumbleFree returns completed or removed nodes to it.
facts.reason: Specific startup, reset, match pause or disc-error caller not read; local routine behavior remains independently documented.
